name: hive-wake
description: Wakes an idle Claude Code session when Hive has unread messages, through hivectl watch.

server_url.title: Hive server URL
server_url.description: MCP endpoint of your Hive server, for example https://hive.example.com/mcp

credential_file.title: Credential file
credential_file.description: Path of the file holding this agent's Hive credential (mode 0600). Leave empty to use hivectl's default location.

hivectl_path.title: hivectl executable
hivectl_path.description: Path or name of the hivectl binary.
